services.desc: Fort Lauderdale is considered the best airboat ride company in Fort Lauderdale and South Florida. Airboat Tours Fort Lauderdale in Florida is a family-based company and has been active for more than 20 years in tourism. The best way to experience the Everglades are through airboat rides and tours. People at Airboat Tours Fort Lauderdale in Florida are true gladesmen and they want to share their experience with other people around the world also. Their families have been doing airboat rides in Everglades even before it became famous. The founders of Airboat Tours Fort Lauderdale Florida are Captain Jim Hale & Braden Escobar.
